title: feat(studio): offer the expression editor on stored field types, so a Studio author can follow the formula-aggregate remedy
body:
Fixes #32576
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 字段检查器在数字、日期、文本等「由人填写」的字段类型上新增「计算值」一栏，可直接写 `expression`;设置后该字段显示为已计算、只读，不再提供默认值。
- 为什么改:#32443 裁决 B 之后，平台对公式求和/求平均的拒绝提示是「改成返回类型的字段并带同一 `expression`」,但检查器只在公式字段上给表达式编辑器，Studio 作者照着提示做不到。
- 风险与回滚：仅 Studio 检查器界面与两条语言包键，不改任何元数据键或服务端行为；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` 里的 `offersStoredExpression`(哪些类型给编辑器)和新的「Computed value」段落;其次是 Read-only 勾选框的 `computedByExpression` 读法。
- 两分钟验证：在 Studio 新建对象，加一个 Number 字段，右侧检查器出现「COMPUTED VALUE」段;输入 `record.amount * 0.2`,刷新后仍在，且 Read-only 显示勾选并禁用。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`: a "Computed value" section with a CEL editor (`record` scope, `FORMULA_ROOTS`, live lint, sibling field picker) on every field type a client otherwise writes. Which types: the spec's `FieldSchema.expression` describe says a non-`formula` field with an `expression` is computed and stored on every write; the engine's stored-expression plan reads exactly that (`def.type !== 'formula' && def.expression`). The editor is offered on every type outside the spec's own server-computed write set `COMPUTED_VALUE_TYPES` (`formula`, `summary`, `autonumber`), read from `@objectstack/spec/data`, never re-listed. A `summary` / `autonumber` that already carries an `expression` still shows it, so the key the engine acts on is never invisible.
- Typing writes `expression` (an existing `{ dialect, source }` envelope keeps its other keys, through the existing `writePredicate`); emptying the editor removes the key outright.
- Computed and read-only once set (`isExpressionComputedField` from `@object-ui/core`, the predicate every write surface already asks): the section shows the computed sentence, the Default value editor is not offered, and the Read-only box reads ticked and disabled with nothing written for it.
- A lint error in the stored editor holds Save under its own site (`storedExpression`), dropped when the editor is not on screen, the same rule the formula site follows.
- Under a `formula` editor, one line aligned with `VIRTUAL_FIELD_AGGREGATE_REMEDY`: a formula stores no value, and changing Type to its return type keeps the expression and stores it. The retype already keeps `expression` (pinned below).
- `@object-ui/i18n` studio namespace (`en`, `zh`): `designer.field.section.computed`, `designer.field.storedExpression`, `designer.field.storedExpression.hint`, `designer.field.storedExpression.computed`, `designer.field.formula.storedHint`. Add-only; the eager locale packs are untouched.
- Prior rulings in the file (objectstack#30905 ruling A, ruling 6574398310 B, objectstack#19629 B, objectui#12681) are untouched.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared harness `ObjectFieldInspector.test.tsx`, "stored expression editor (objectstack#32576)", 10 cases: offered on `number` with the hint; a `number` field with an expression saves, passes `FieldSchema.safeParse`, round-trips, and reads as computed and read-only; emptying removes the key; envelope preserved; formula keeps its own editor plus the hint; not offered on `summary` / `autonumber`; shown on a `summary` already carrying one; retype formula to number keeps the expression; a lint error gates Save and stops once the editor is gone. The harness also gains module-top `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint` imports that `check:test-source-alias` asked for once the file was edited.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

On `01b4f61b0`, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` mutated `offersStoredExpression`'s return to `false && (...)`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `f18372c77b14` to `78f7b64f72f9`. Result: 7 failed, 3 passed (the three negative cases: formula, summary, autonumber). Restore: blob after restore `f18372c77b14` equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- On `01b4f61b0`, under the verify lock: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ packages/i18n/src/__tests__/studio-namespace.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/appDesigner-fieldDesigner-formula-retired-6310.test.ts`: Test Files 232 passed, Tests 3013 passed, 1 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` exit 0 (both include `tsconfig.test.json`).
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands` on `01b4f61b0`), run locally with exit 0: all listed families except the three below, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`. `check:test-source-alias` was red on the edited harness, fixed in `744ad7992`, then exit 0. `check:query-options-erasure` exit 0 on re-run.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `check:type-check-debt` (exit 3, the verify lock was never acquired: nothing measured) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (lock queue timeout). The harness file's last two commits (module-top imports, changeset text) were not re-run under the lock for the same reason. CI runs all three.
- eslint on the four changed source files: 0 errors (warnings are the file's existing `any` pattern).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `FieldSchema` parses `expression` on every type, `summary` and `autonumber` included, and the engine's stored-expression plan would compute it on those too, beside their own producer. The inspector does not offer the editor there (it reads `COMPUTED_VALUE_TYPES`). Whether the spec should refuse that pair is not measured here; noted, not filed.
- The form designer canvas in Studio still draws a computed field as an input; it is a layout surface, outside this card's file surface.
- `returnType` stays on a field retyped from formula to number; the spec accepts it there and nothing reads it off a formula. Unchanged here.

## Verification

Browser check on this container's Chromium (Playwright, `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`), `examples/app-todo` backend `--fresh --seed-admin` plus the Console Vite dev server from this worktree. A new writable package (Repairs) and object (Repair Ticket) were made in Studio, with Number fields Fee and Amount.

<details><summary>Before (inspector reverted to the merge base, the rest unchanged)</summary>

Fee (Number) inspector sections: BASIC, NUMBER OPTIONS, ADVANCED, VISIBLE WHEN, REQUIRED WHEN. No expression editor anywhere (`textarea[id^=field-stored-expression-]` count 0, no "Formula (CEL)" or "Computed from"). The card reproduces.

</details>

<details><summary>After</summary>

- Fee: sections BASIC, NUMBER OPTIONS, COMPUTED VALUE, ADVANCED. Empty editor with the hint, Default value shown, Read-only unticked and enabled.
- Typed `record.amount * 0.2`: autosave `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/repairs_repair_ticket` (draft) 200. The stored draft reads back as `"fee":{"type":"number","label":"Fee","expression":"record.amount * 0.2"}`.
- New browser session, reselect Fee: editor holds `record.amount * 0.2`, the computed line shows, Default value not offered, Read-only checked=true disabled=true.
- Published the package, then inserted a record with `amount: 250, fee: 7`: stored `fee` is 50. The engine computed it and the client-sent value did not stand.

</details>
